hero.intro: Hands-on tech lead with 12+ years building software and growing teams. I code every day in Python, PHP and Node.js, and I care most about clean architecture, how work gets shipped and the people doing it.

achievements.engineers: Engineers on the team I led

about.title: About Me
about.text: Tech lead based in Braga, Portugal, working remotely. At a B2B pharmaceutical startup I stepped up to lead the team within 6 months, grew it from 4 to ~10 engineers and introduced CI/CD and Terraform, taking releases from 2–4 hours to under 20 minutes. At a large e-commerce company I led the zero-downtime migration of a legacy PHP monolith into Node.js microservices with RabbitMQ. I still code every day with FastAPI, Symfony, Laravel and TypeScript, mentor developers and lead incident response on AWS and Kubernetes.
